ItemID: 1; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful alongside my imperial rivet nuts, but I would check the required screw length before choosing this pack.
ItemID: 2; Title: 5/16 x 5-1/2" (8 pcs) Hex Lag Screws, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Hexagon Head Lag Bolts, Hex Head Wood Screws; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These long lag screws seem too specific without a current heavy wood fastening job.
ItemID: 3; Title: M3-0.5 x 12mm (100 PCS) Socket Head Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 12.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Coarse Thread UNC, DIN 912; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Small metric hardware fits my repair interests, but my existing assortment may already cover this size.
ItemID: 4; Title: AmazonCommercial 44 Gallon Heavy Duty Round Trash/Garbage Can, Grey, 4-pck; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no apparent need for four large commercial trash cans while shopping for workshop supplies.
ItemID: 5; Title: VIGRUE 310 Pcs #6 1/2'' to 1'' #8 1/2'' to 1-1/2'' Wood Screws Black Oxide Coated Stainless Steel Flat Head Phillips Drywall Screw Assortment Kit, Self Tapping Screws Kit in 8 Sizes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Multiple sizes suit the varied DIY work reflected in my history, and I have chosen VIGRUE hardware before.
ItemID: 6; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have an identified pressure measurement task needing this range and fitting.
ItemID: 7; Title: Realth Magnets Disc Neodymium 0.79” x 0.08” 10 Pack Round Permanent Rare Earth Magnetic for Fridge Office Science Project Craft(MC20210); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These look useful for removable fixtures and craft projects alongside my adhesive mounting supplies.
ItemID: 8; Title: Mornajina Dial Indicator with Magnetic Base 0-10mm Tester Gage, Dial Test Indicator 0.01mm Precision, Magnetic Dial Indicator Base Holder with Fine Adjustment; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: It could complement my caliper for checking alignment and movement during mechanical DIY work.
ItemID: 9; Title: M6-1.0 x 16mm (30 PCS) Countersunk Head Socket Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 10.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Full Thread, Coarse Thread, DIN 7991; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: M6 fasteners fit my recent hardware interests, but I would need a matching countersunk application before buying thirty.
ItemID: 10; Title: #6 (100 pcs) Stainless Steel Spring Lock Washers, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8 Regular helical Spring Lock washers, ASME/ANSI B18.21.1; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Relevant to assembling hardware, but I would first check whether my current projects need this particular washer size.
